description: This file defines the class 'perf_oci8' which extends from 'adodb_perf'. It contains functionality for performance monitoring, database diagnostics, and Oracle database-specific analysis tools such as SQL analysis, cache advice, wait events, and system parameters. The class utilizes Oracle dynamic performance views and provides methods for analyzing and explaining SQL statements, checking memory, and retrieving database statistics.

classes.name: perf_oci8
classes.description: Performance monitoring and diagnostic class tailored for Oracle OCI8 extension in PHP, providing methods to analyze database performance, explain SQL, and retrieve system metrics.

methods.name: LogMode
methods.description: Returns instructions for enabling or disabling archive log mode in Oracle.

methods.name: TopRecentWaits
methods.description: Retrieves top 5 recent wait events from Oracle's system event views.

methods.name: TopHistoricalWaits
methods.description: Retrieves historical wait event data over the past specified days.

methods.name: TableSpace
methods.description: Provides information on tablespaces and datafiles including used vs max size.

methods.name: RMAN
methods.description: Fetches recent RMAN (Recovery Manager) job status details.

methods.name: DynMemoryUsage
methods.description: Provides current dynamic memory component sizes in Oracle.

methods.name: FlashUsage
methods.description: Displays current Flash Recovery Area usage statistics.

methods.name: WarnPageCost
methods.description: Provides warning message based on the current optimizer page cost parameter.

methods.name: WarnIndexCost
methods.description: Provides warning message based on current index cache cost setting.

methods.name: PGA
methods.description: Placeholder method, potentially for future implementation related to PGA info.

methods.name: PGA_Advice
methods.description: Provides an estimate and guidance for optimizing PGA size based on Oracle's hints and advisories.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL statement.

methods.name: CheckMemory
methods.description: Analyzes and reports on Oracle memory structures and recommends adjustments.

methods.name: tohtml
methods.description: Converts an Oracle query result set into an HTML table for display.

methods.name: SuspiciousSQL
methods.description: Analyzes and lists SQL statements with high buffer gets or executions indicating potential performance issues.

methods.name: ExpensiveSQL
methods.description: Lists SQL statements with high disk reads or other expensive operations.

methods.name: clearsql
methods.description: Deletes old performance logs from the performance monitoring table.
